verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs list integer quantization including INT8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF and compressed-tensors, and state that quantization is used to cut memory footprint. A community comment notes the library's broad low-precision model support. One early launch-thread comment said 4-bit was unsupported, but current docs explicitly list INT4 and GPTQ/AWQ, so I treat it as outdated rather than a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of sub-4-bit (2/3-bit) integer support, in-depth per-format docs on bit-widths, and independent hands-on corroboration of memory savings.
